beats.objective: Bring dinner to {whistleblower.first}, who asked for you by name

first_night.speaker: patron
first_night.text: Election posters cover every wall of {patron.place}: {incumbent.name} on the left, {challenger.name} on the right. {patron.first} {patron.family} hands you a bag. "Vote's in a week. Until then, everyone's hungry and everyone's lying."

fixer_offer.speaker: fixer
fixer_offer.text: {fixer.first} {fixer.family} catches you on the stairs. "Couriers go everywhere and nobody looks at them. A few sealed envelopes for {incumbent.name}, a little extra each time. Interested?"

voter_envelope.speaker: voter
voter_envelope.text: {voter.first} {voter.family} opens the envelope at the door and counts the notes inside. "Tell {fixer.first} my whole floor votes the right way." The door shuts.

voter_canvass.speaker: voter
voter_canvass.text: {voter.first} {voter.family} reads the leaflet twice. "{challenger.name}, eh? My floor was paid to forget them. Maybe someone should remember."

threat.speaker: disruptor
threat.text: {disruptor.name} have been hired to keep the streets 'calm' until the vote. Calm means couriers who carry the wrong things end up in the fog.

whistleblower_door.speaker: whistleblower
whistleblower_door.text: {whistleblower.first} {whistleblower.family} pulls you inside. "I keep {incumbent.name}'s books. Here's the ledger: every bribe, every floor they bought. I can't carry it out. You can."

choices.text: Burn it. Nobody wins this one.

epilogue_expose.speaker: challenger
epilogue_expose.text: The ledger is read aloud in every stairwell. {incumbent.name} loses the council, and the new councillors open the district's food stores.

epilogue_sold.speaker: fixer
epilogue_sold.text: {fixer.first} pays in clean notes and never mentions it again. {incumbent.name} wins by a landslide. {whistleblower.first}'s flat is empty by Monday.

epilogue_quiet.speaker: whistleblower
epilogue_quiet.text: The ledger curls in the flame. {incumbent.name} wins, as they always do. {whistleblower.first} thanks you for not making them a martyr.
